fichas.title: Controlled ventilation of homes
fichas.summary: Explains background and demand-controlled ventilation, including recommended air-change rates for residential and sanitary rooms and kitchens. Centralised ventilation with heat recovery filters incoming outside air and transfers warmth from extract air; kitchen and bathroom air should not flow into other rooms.
uses: Provide hygienic indoor air by removing odours, water vapour and CO₂
Limit building damage associated with inadequate air exchange

dimensions.label: Background air exchange rate
dimensions.context: Minimum stated rate to help prevent building damage through normal use.

dimensions.label: Recommended air changes in residential, occupied and bedrooms
dimensions.context: Recommended for hygienic reasons.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 0.5–1.0 times per hour in residential, occupied and bedrooms

dimensions.label: Recommended air changes in internal sanitary rooms
dimensions.context: Recommended for hygienic reasons.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 4–5 times per hour in internal sanitary rooms

dimensions.label: Recommended air changes in kitchens
dimensions.context: Intermittent requirement; as printed in the source.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 0.5–25 times per hour in kitchens (intermittent requirement)

dimensions.label: Heat recovery from extract air
dimensions.context: Minimum recoverable waste heat stated for mechanical ventilation with heat recovery.
dimensions.ocr_raw: At least 80% of the waste heat

fichas.title: Central air extract systems and common extract ducts
fichas.summary: Describes heat recovery from central air extraction using a heat pump and storage in a domestic hot-water cylinder, and single ventilation systems using a common vertical extract duct. Outside air enters through openings and joints; airtight backflow flaps help prevent heat loss and odour nuisance and provide fire protection.
uses: Recover extract-air heat using a heat pump
Route exhaust through a shared vertical duct
Reduce heat loss and odour transfer when fans are off

fichas.title: Controlled domestic ventilation with ground-source heat exchanger
fichas.summary: A ground-source heat exchanger cools incoming air in summer and pre-warms it in winter. The page also gives scheduled flow volumes for windowless rooms, with separate values for background operation and demand-controlled operation.
uses: Pre-cool incoming outside air in summer
Pre-warm incoming outside air in winter
Supply scheduled ventilation flow to windowless rooms
